Maya Chen: 15-mins til all-hands. Quick preflight: cameras, stream, local recorder? Any last-minute notes?
Lin (SRE): Recorder healthy. Saw OBS spike earlier from a plugin; disabled the suspect plugin and pinned the fallback RTMP. Devon, recheck camera framing?
Devon - AV: Camera 2 had white balance shift, fixed. Audio levels bumped +2dB on Presenter channel. Using wired ethernet for the room.
Priya Gomez: I moved the "Dedicated Optimize" bullet up next to roadmap. Chris wants only a one-liner.
Chris - CEO: Keep it tight. Also will call out hiring priority for infra roles during leadership remarks.
Maya Chen: Reminder: if the stream disconnects, follow the "stream-fallback" runbook (link in pinned). Also we'll swap to Customer Q&A after infra update.
Lin (SRE): Quick command if obs stops responding:
```
sudo systemctl restart obs.service || sudo pkill -9 obs && /usr/bin/obs &
journalctl -u obs.service -n 80 --no-pager
```
Devon - AV: If local recorder stops, use the HDMI passthrough to plugin B-cam and record locally on the backup recorder.
recorder-bot: Upload started: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/2790024680/part-1.mp4
Priya Gomez: Queueing a leadership Q from @Priya: "What's the plan to balance latency reductions vs unit cost for hosted customers?"
Chris - CEO: I'll address the high-level tradeoff. Product can follow up in AMA. Raj not needed on this one.
Maya Chen: Final note: presenters should mute when not speaking. See you in 10. :camera_flash:
